Definition: {the heart; also used (figuratively) very widely for the feelings, the will and even the intellect; likewise for the centre of anything}
BiblicalUsage: lêb means the heart — rare in the text, and exact where it appears. In Daniel 7:28, "my cogitations much troubled me".
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Daniel's troubled heart shows me that true visions shake the seer — God's revelations are not entertainment, they are weight.
